LESSON: HEALING OF THE PARALYTIC

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Miracles of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Healing of the Paralytic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Healing of the Paralytic. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How does the healing of the paralytic build your faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the healing of the paralytic

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the healing of the paralytic
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the healing of the paralytic. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Healing of the Paralytic using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Healing of the Paralytic in the examples.
2. Explain Healing of the Paralytic to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Healing of the Paralytic.
4. Show that you can: describe the healing of the paralytic

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of the Paralytic using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Healing of the Paralytic important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read and discuss Luke 5:17-26 and make a presentation in class using charts, posters or Power Point slides,
2. Discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the paralytic and make notes,
3. Digital literacy: The skill of using digital learning platforms is enhanced as learners watch a movie on the healing of the paralytic.
4. Self-efficacy: The skill of self-awareness is portrayed as learners write a personal reflection journal on occasions when God answered their prayers. Pertinent and contemporary issues (PCIs):
5. Effective communication: The learners share personal experiences on instances when they prayed to God for healing.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the healing of the paralytic

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
